name: Robo House
author: Foppygames
description: A one-screen platformer: run, climb the ladders and jump over the robots to rescue the kittens in the house. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: A one-screen platformer: run, climb the ladders and jump over the robots to rescue the kittens in the house. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Un platform a schermata singola: corri, sali le scale e salta i robot per salvare i gattini della casa. Croce direzionale e Salto sullo schermo. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
